title: The lifecycle in the Composition API

videos.script:
A component has a life. It is created, put on the page, updated, and removed. {{hooks}} Vue calls a function of yours at each of those moments, and those functions are the lifecycle hooks. You will watch one component announce every moment of its life.

{{order}} Then the order, with a parent and two children. Creation goes down the tree, and mounting comes back up.

{{refs}} Then template refs, a hand on the real element. A field appears because you asked for it, and the focus goes into it.

{{leak}} Then the leak. A component is removed, and its timer keeps ticking ten times a second. And the planner gets a clock of its own, which it starts and stops properly.

{{setup}} Then a question people bring from React. Should a request start in setup or in onMounted? In Vue, the answer is setup.

{{alive}} And last, KeepAlive. A note typed in one tab is still there when you come back.
